label: v3-ecommerce-galpao
prompt: Generate a professional photorealistic variation of this image. PRESERVE the same person (same model, same face, same pose, same expression, same tablet in hand), the same lighting quality and color grading, and the same overall composition structure. CHANGE: (1) Remove the apron — the person should wear a casual t-shirt or simple blouse only, no apron or work uniform; (2) Replace the background entirely with a logistics warehouse or fulfillment center environment: industrial space with high ceilings, metal shelving units stacked floor to ceiling with dozens of cardboard e-commerce boxes, conveyor belts or pallets visible, warehouse lighting (fluorescent or industrial overhead lights), concrete floor. The environment should feel large-scale, commercial, and logistics-focused — NOT a home or decorated space. The boxes should be abundant and fill the background. Result must be photorealistic, professional lifestyle photography quality.
